name: KRACHT
author: S.Kracht
description: Hard techno drums: synthesised kick designer (EXHALE ...), the rumble made from your kick, hats, clap, 16 steps, the kick sidechains IN 1+2, GATE OUT, 16 performance FX on SHIFT + pads, note repeat, overdub, quantize, fills, scenes, polymeter, MIDI in and out (GM / MPC / learn maps, clock)
